name: Apply Wall Finish (Roll Method)
intent: Roll the wall field with an 18-inch roller. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios that need two coats list this module twice in the modules[] sequence. Coat 2 is slightly faster on smooth walls (less lap reworking) and same-rate on textured walls. Cut-in to trim is handled by the standalone MOD_APPLY_CUTIN_TRIM module which fires in parallel.
doctrine: Roll rate is texture-driven: smooth walls accept paint cleanly, textured walls require slower laydown to fill profile. Baseline (340 LF/hr) is the smooth coat-1 rate. Textured variants (orange_peel, knockdown) are produced by FAC_TEXTURE (see Modifiers tab) — tune there to adjust texture sensitivity without touching this module. Coat 2 runs ~12% faster on smooth walls (coat_2_rate_multiplier = 1.118); FAC_TEXTURE still applies on coat 2 so textured coat 2 compounds the speedup and texture slowdown. Cut-in to trim is handled by the standalone MOD_APPLY_CUTIN_TRIM module which fires in parallel to the wall roll rounds.
